intent: To illustrate the substantial proportion of cannabis cultivation that takes place indoors in the United States.

units.meaning: Indoor cultivation accounts for 33.3% of U.S. cannabis cultivation.
accepted_routes: Indoor accounts for 33.3% of U.S. cannabis cultivation.
A third of America's cannabis cultivation is indoors.
The indoor slice of the cultivation donut is about 33%.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A chart mark labeled 'indoor' must fill about one-third of the ring.
units.temporal_anchor: The main clause stating that one-third/33.3% of America's weed is grown indoors.
units.reviewer_question: Must the exact 33.3% be shown, or is "about one-third" sufficient?

optional_valid: Calling it a 'substantial' share is acceptable, but it must not become 'majority'.
unsupported_to_avoid: Saying indoor cultivation is the majority/most, because 33.3% is below half.
Saying the remaining 66.7% is specifically outdoor unless the table labels it outdoor.
Causal claims about why cultivation is indoors.
Trend or increase claims, since there is no time series.
Treating 33.3 as a count of farms or as 0.333%.
notes: 表里只有一个 indoor 份额，按旁白 one-third 取 33.3%（环上弧长 35%）。
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
